Maya (Product): Quick preflight for next Wed's webinar 'Serving with Predictable Latency' 3: need speaker confirmations, 1-line abstracts for the event page, rehearsal slot, and two promo hooks (benchmark stat + customer quote).

Ilya (Marketing): I can draft two hooks: 1) 'Reduce per-token cost by 3x with smart batching' and 2) 'Keep p99 latency under 200ms during 10x spikes'. Which resonates more?

Priya (Growth): Both. Use the latency stat for dev communities, cost stat for procurement/finance audiences. We'll A/B the hero copy.

Ruth (Events): Rehearsal slots available Tue 11:00 or Tue 16:00. Recommend 16:00 for US/EU overlap. Please RSVP.

Diego (Design): I'll produce 3 assets: hero image, 15s social clip, and a 3-slide benchmark teaser. Need final stat and speaker headshots by Mon noon.

Maya (Product): Speakers: me (product), Tom (runtime eng), and customer (Acme AI) - Sarah confirmed. Abstracts: I'll drop 1-liners in the doc in 10m.

Sam (SDR): Lead routing ask: tag by poll response + time-attended. Will take handoffs for high-interest leads. Please include poll: "Which matters most? latency / cost / isolation"

Ilya (Marketing): Promo schedule: 2 emails (announcement, reminder), 3 social pushes, community post. Drafts due Mon EOD.

stagebot: Recording enabled. Backstage channel #webinar-backstage created and invites sent.

Maya (Product): Owners summary: Abstracts & speaker notes = Maya; Promo copy + send = Ilya; Assets = Diego; Rehearsal logistics = Ruth; Lead routing = Sam; Growth A/B = Priya. Rehearsal Tue 16:00 confirmed. Closing thread.

Priya (Growth): I'll kick off the landing page A/B tonight.

Diego (Design): Headshots uploaded. Starting assets now.
